# Burning Springs: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Locations 80 to 110

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 22, 2025
- 10 min read

Updated: Dec 3, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_47b6430322754193a89ed45b85db2d98~mv2.jpg)

With thanks to Spacelime

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

This route is meant to be run from

**80 to 110**

Some spawns are out of the way and rely on the previous spawn to reach the next one. I set the path up so you can grab the briefcases needed for the Abraxo weapons as fast as possible.

Each location has a tick box under it so you can mark them off as you go.

If you want the full list all on one page, use the

Burning Springs: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Rewards and Checklist

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 80**

Fast Travel Point:

- Highway Town > Exterior

Directions:

From the spawn in location, run straight, go through the elevator platform, and stop at the campfire on the other side next to the brahmin pen on your right.

Face East, and the briefcase is on the back of the green car trailer, next to the metal barrel.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_439d495b7c7647a48bd15fecf0cf45d2~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 81**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face southwest and run over to the bus. Jump onto the roof and turn to face South. You’ll see a highway on-ramp ahead. Run over to it and follow the ramp upward. The briefcase is on the back seat of the limo near the top of the ramp.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3c4b8f810deb4223bde6da3ceadd2e43~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 82**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, jump onto the limo and stand on the very edge of the bonnet. Jump the gap to the next section of the ramp and stop at the end.

Face North, walk down the wooden ramp, follow the path around, and stop at the top of the stairs. Turn West and walk straight, veering slightly right to get around the pillar in front of you. Interact with the door marked “Exit” and enter the Highway Town interior.

Once you load in, walk over to the stairs on your left and stop at the bottom. Face West and go into the shipping container ahead. The briefcase is on the ground on the right, leaning against a metal shelf and a wooden crate.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c76c9e09c75b452bbfaec9fd2b19735c~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 83**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the shipping container, turn southwest, and walk back to the exit door. Go through it to leave the building.

Face northeast and follow the path. Go up the stairs, turn right, head up the ramp, and keep following the path all the way to the end until you reach the guard post.

Face West and either take the stairs or jetpack up to the next floor. Stop at the bottom of the stairs and turn right. Walk forward to the railing at the edge. Turn left, go up the next set of stairs, and stop at the bar. The briefcase is behind the bar on the metal shelf in the corner.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0768b0de10f8402e9c6d99c8788ea0a2~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 84**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face southeast and go up the stairs in front of you. Follow the path west, jump over the rail at the end, and stop at the red and blue flowers in the middle.

Face South and walk over to the metal trailer ahead. Open the door and turn right. The briefcase is on the metal shelf at the end of the trailer.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dbe1f028088b49ff9bb3115a8844a18e~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 85**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the trailer and close the door. Face east and go up the stairs in front of you. Walk forward, jump the gap, and land on the roof of the next building. Drop through the hole in the roof and face west. Take a few steps forward and stop at the bottom of the stairs. Face south and walk to the window. Turn east and follow the path around, and you’ll find the briefcase on the wooden bookcase in front of you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b4d370c27c9a49a4ae3939d5545a58ff~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 86**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around and go back to the stairs. Go up the stairs, exit the building, and face South. Walk all the way to the railing and look down. You can jetpack down, jump onto the ramp and work your way down, climb into your power armour and do a superhero landing, or, if you line it up properly, shift slightly left and jump straight into the water.

Once you’re back on the ground, face North and walk over to the water purifiers. Turn East and you’ll see the briefcase floating in the water in front of you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_07446c70e9b24aa1b562d37614709117~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 87**

Fast Travel Point:

- Highway Town > Main Entrance

Directions:

From the motorbike statue, face South and either jump over or walk around the statue, then look up. Jump onto the platform above, go inside the room, and turn left.

You’ll see a locked metal door ahead. There’s a keypad on the wall to the left and a puzzle on the right that gives you the code for the keypad.

You can solve the puzzle, or you can use the code listed at the very bottom of this guide.

Once the door is open, the briefcase is on the table to your right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e4411a3ce9474a1ea37f3b9f878c3860~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 88**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around, exit the room, and drop back down to the ground floor. Walk back to the motorbike statue and face East. Move forward, veering slightly right to get around the wall, and stop on the other side. Face North and drop down to the floor below. Turn North, and the briefcase will be in front of you on the ground, between the stairs and the shipping container.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4e0b312f6b434e1e8d17bed31b5da73b~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 89**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn and go back up the stairs. Face West and take the path on the right. Walk forward, go past the motorbike statue, and slowly look up as you move. Stop when you reach the bathtub hanging from the roof on your right. Turn North and jump up to the platform above. Face West, walk forward, and stop at the last bedroom on your right. Go inside and turn left. The briefcase is leaning against the yellow chair on the western wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a8f118b97c1d4cfc8640fc216cf01c2a~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 90**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around, exit the room, and drop back down to ground level. Walk forward a few steps and turn West. Follow the path straight, veering slightly left to get around the wall. Stop when you reach The Last Resort and face southeast. Walk over to the gun vendor in front of you and use the door on the left to get behind the counter. Head to the southern corner and go into the room. The briefcase is under the bed, sitting on a wooden crate.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_42fa27ab7e0643a5b212144a2ec41f37~mv2.jpg)

Reward Unlocked: Super Duper Mart Store Shelf

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6d073989a4e74f9baf49c4f608bfd9b7~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 91**

Fast Travel Point:

- Shade Hill Church

Directions:

From the spawn in location, face West and run over to the white building in front of you. Go inside the church, and the briefcase is on the pew on the right-hand side, next to the skeleton, in front of you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b5a8200fecb5497f8c112bd6df166f60~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 92**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face east and exit the church. Follow the path and stop when you reach the main road. Turn left and follow the road until you reach the white “33” sign. Turn right and walk to the bridge. On your left is a concrete viewing platform and an orange metal cart. Walk over to the cart, and the briefcase is inside it.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e7771b0913984ba2a230b462a7d35092~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 93**

Fast Travel Point:

- Super Duper Mart

Directions:

From the spawn in location, run over to the white building in front of you and stop at the green dumpster on the corner. The building is missing its roof, so be careful not to fall through when you jump up onto it. Face South and walk along the edge of the building. Jump over the wall, land on the other side, and still facing South, walk up the ramp in front of you. Keep going until you reach the hole in the roof. Drop through the hole and, if you lined it up properly, the briefcase will be right in front of you on the metal shelf.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2b4e4f6132c74a8ba65b0ca7e7800d94~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 94**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face north and walk forward, veering left to get around the roof. Keep heading north until you’re standing at the base of the Super Duper Mart sign in the car park.

Face northwest, walk forward, and follow the road until you reach the bus stop on your right. Turn north and walk around behind the wall of the bus stop. The briefcase is to the right of the green dumpster, leaning against the wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4345902833844f03985bb63bdc83b2d8~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 95**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, jump onto the bus shelter and face northeast. Run straight until you reach a dirt wall. Climb up onto the ground above and keep heading northeast. You’ll see a junk pile vein in front of you. The briefcase is in the middle of the junk pile, next to the blue oven.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_36099a4b6357462c997637b76cc1fdaa~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 96**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face northeast and walk up the hill to the white house on your left. The briefcase is on the front porch, next to a wooden crate and a skeleton.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2cd10559d4644d719a3b76aa4c1f71f4~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 97**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face South and run over to the ruined house. Jump over the wall, and you should land in the basement. Face West, and the briefcase will be in the bathtub, next to the green ammo box.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ef912f313e93400c86598afbad53ca24~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 98**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, walk back up the stairs, face North, and jump over the wall. Head back to the white house and jump onto the roof. Face North and you’ll see a grey house and a shed in front of you. Run down the hill toward the shed on the left.

Go inside the shed and follow it around to the end. The briefcase is on the bench at the far end.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6249521a9cb4469780c233f0787b086e~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 99**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the shed and climb onto the roof. Face West and run straight until you’re standing in the middle of the riverbed. Turn north and follow the riverbed under the stone bridge, stopping at the small boat in the center.

Face northeast and you’ll see a rusty ute/pickup truck reversing a boat into the river. The briefcase is in that boat, at the end closest to you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4e16cdedf77b49c2951502244ecfd7b8~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 100**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face northwest and run forward until you reach the main road. Turn right and follow it over the train tracks and around the bend until you reach the boat hire shed at the end. Head inside. The briefcase is just inside the second door, on the ground next to the Nuka-Cola machine.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d7b00e8bde4e4836b684969acd9d6fc2~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 101**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the building, face North, and walk down to the water’s edge. Follow the shoreline with the water on your right. Keep going until you reach the white capsized boat. The briefcase will be on top of the boat, at the end.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_054becd7302b46c0851c93bce46bed50~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 102**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, continue following the shoreline with the water on your right. Stop when you reach the raft in the water. Face North and run up the hill. Go inside the red trailer and turn left. The briefcase is under the dresser on your left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_073adcff6d974f66ba9cbd25ede9379e~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 103**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

Level 0 Locked Door

From the spawn above, face South and run until you reach the train tracks. Turn east and follow the tracks over the red metal bridge, then stop at the white lookout tower on your right. Go around and enter the tower via the stairs. The briefcase is leaning against the wooden desk along the northern wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dbc26ff2cff34e85b4f6f890dda278c2~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 104**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the building and walk back to the train tracks. Follow the tracks East until you reach a dead end. The briefcase is inside the collapsed tunnel, in front of you, against the right-hand wall.

Might want to keep an eye on the Radhog spawns here as well.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d2c81e0d41a1435c93239f221bb015a9~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 105**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around and follow the train tracks back until you reach the three blue train carriages. Climb onto the top of the first carriage and face southeast. You’ll see a red toolbox inside a cave ahead. Run over and enter the cave. The briefcase is on the rocks along the southern side.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_190eb9b446734398909c78ae534a7430~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 106**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, exit the cave, face South, and climb up onto the rocks. Run forward and make your way onto the roof of the house ahead. Keep facing South and you’ll see a small red shed on your left. Head over and go inside. The briefcase is on top of the metal barrel on your left.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c11ae03d5b7644eaa5f281af5bc7fade~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 107**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, jump onto the roof and face southeast. Run forward and stop at the edge of the cliff. There’s a small shed below you. Drop down to the ground and go through the door on your left. The briefcase is on your left, just inside the doorway next to a skeleton.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_240170652b6c4692b1bcf68638f68b91~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 108**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, jump onto the roof of the building, face south, and run forward. Go past the two dinosaurs and slow down when you see the building ahead. Veer right and head toward the green dumpster on the corner. The briefcase is inside the dumpster.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_419f53a4a7c345ffb6587afe56914614~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 109**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, jump up onto the roof, face east, and follow the roof to the end. Turn toward the northeast and run forward toward the back of the park. Stop at the triceratops and face east. Walk over to the right side of the food stall and turn north. The briefcase is inside the fridge that’s blocking the doorway.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8847c27fd5ec496fa84ff80320f1d362~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 110**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, jump onto the roof of the food stall and face east. Run up the hill while staying on an east line, and you’ll see a white building at the top. Adjust your path and enter the small church. The briefcase is on the left side, under the last pew at the back of the church, near the door.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8ccab8ea106448bf90ea55c1bc44593d~mv2.jpg)

Reward Unlocked: Abraxo HQ Wall Sign

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_205e9be6cf594fe9b59347405af4cdd1~mv2.jpg)

**Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase 87**

Door Code: OPEN = 1867
